name: kirizuma_minka
notes: Gabled timber-frame farmhouse: white shikkui plaster infill between dark_oak posts/beams, shoji glass panels, deep slate tile gable with ridge cap, and a small entrance canopy on porch posts.

name: yosemune_engawa
notes: Hip-roof (yosemune) house in spruce: clapboard shitami-ita shadow lines protruding on the side walls, shoji windows front/back, four-sided stepped tile hip with deep eaves, and an L-shaped raised engawa veranda with a stepping stone.

name: machiya_koushi
notes: Tall street-facing townhouse: dark plank ground floor screened by iron-bar koushi lattice, white plaster upper floor with small mushiko-mado barred openings, shoji on the flanks, a mid-storey pent eave (F>=2), and a black-tile gable with timber ridge.

name: shirakabe_kura
notes: Whitewashed kura storehouse: thick rounded white-plaster corners, lower namako-kabe black diamond grid, small high iron-bar windows, cobblestone plinth, a heavy gray-tile gable with a plaster hachimaki band and spruce bargeboards (hafu) on the gable ends.

name: sukiya_chashitsu
notes: Sukiya teahouse: earthen packed-mud walls with stripped-log posts and oak sills, a round marumado shoji window, a low broad hipped clay-tile roof with very deep 2-block eaves on full-height veranda posts, a spruce-slab engawa deck, and moss/mossy-stone garden steppers.

name: kyo_machiya_bengara
notes: Kyoto machiya: white-plaster upper with iron-bar mushiko-mado windows, bengara koushido lattice shopfront, dark nageshi beam bands, spruce posts, and a stepped deep tiled eave (hisashi).

name: shitamiita_shoka
notes: Clapboard merchant house: spruce shitami-ita lap siding (alternating slab/full for shadow lines), white-plaster top floor with windows, dark-oak pilaster posts, and blackstone hisashi eaves at every floor line.

name: tsumairi_gable_shop
notes: Tsumairi shop: big pitched slab gable roof facing the street with dark-oak hafu gable boards, plaster gable triangle, koushi shopfront, protruding sode-kabe wing walls at the front corners, and a front shop canopy.

name: shinkabe_yosemune
notes: Shinkabe post-and-beam: exposed dark-oak timber grid framing white-plaster panels, full iron-bar koushi shopfront, mushiko/glass upper openings, and a pyramidal yosemune hip roof of tiles with a deep overhanging eave.

name: shoten_noren_balcony
notes: Bengara shop: fully open glazed shopfront with a dark-oak kanban signboard band, deep protruding hisashi canopy, a 2F balcony floor plus stone-brick-wall railing balusters, red-terracotta/plaster upper with lattice, and a low tiled roof.

name: showa_danchi
notes: Classic 1960s-70s concrete danchi: vertical PC-panel joints + horizontal slab bands, regular light-blue window rows over white spandrels, protruding concrete sills front & back, parapet with slab coping.

name: bunka_corridor
notes: Timber-and-mortar bunka-jutaku: spruce plank walls with spruce_log studs/corners, front engawa external corridor (spruce_slab deck) with iron_bars balustrade and spruce_log newel posts, per-floor eave canopy and a mono-pitch ridge cap.
code:
def build(W, D, F, put, M):
    H=F*4
    body='minecraft:spruce_planks'; post='minecraft:spruce_log'
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            for z in range(D):
                if not (x in (0,W-1) or z in (0,D-1)): continue
                corner=x in (0,W-1) and z in (0,D-1)
                run=x if z in (0,D-1) else z
                name=body
                if corner: name=post
                elif run%2==0 and y%4!=0: name=post          # timber studs
                if z==D-1 and not corner and run%2==1 and y%4 in (2,3):
                    name='minecraft:white_concrete'          # mortar back wall
                if z==0 and not corner and run%2==1 and y%4==2:
                    name='minecraft:glass'                   # room windows
                put(x,y,z,name)
    for f in range(F):            # external corridor (engawa) on front z=-1
        fy=f*4
        for x in range(-1,W):
            put(x,fy,-1,'minecraft:spruce_slab')             # walkway deck
            if x%3==0: put(x,fy+1,-1,'minecraft:spruce_log') # newel posts
            else: put(x,fy+1,-1,'minecraft:iron_bars')       # balustrade
        for x in range(-1,W):
            put(x,fy+3,-1,'minecraft:spruce_slab')           # eave/canopy
    for x in range(-1,W+1):       # mono-pitch ridge cap
        put(x,H,0,'minecraft:dark_oak_slab')

name: veranda_mansion
notes: Low-rise mansion with continuous cantilevered balconies: full-height glazing on the front, single window rows on the rear, quartz_slab balcony decks protruding to z=-1 with 2-tall iron_bars railings and solid end cheeks, quartz-slab parapet coping.

name: kaidan_tower
notes: Stairwell-access danchi (階段室型): symmetric light-blue window wings over gray spandrels, a central glazed stair tower protruding two blocks (z=-1,-2) with gray landing bands every floor, capped by its own coping above the main parapet.

name: danchi_renewal
notes: Renovated/repainted danchi: PC panels tinted per column from a 5-color terracotta cycle with gray corners and horizontal cornice bands, light-blue window rows, a rear access walkway (z=D) with alternating stone_brick_wall posts and iron_bars, and protruding red-sandstone window hoods on the front.

name: Zakkyo Tenant Tower
notes: 雑居ビル: floor-by-floor colored signboard bands, vertical neon window strips, a protruding sign pylon, ground canopy, rooftop water-tank.

name: Glass Curtain Wall
notes: Full glass field with a strong mullion grid: protruding thin wall posts vertically, spandrel bands, corner piers, coped parapet, rooftop AC array.

name: Tile-clad Vertical Windows
notes: タイル貼り縦連窓: brown-tile piers between tall glass ribbons, full-height protruding tile pilasters, black ground signage band, cornice slab + parapet.

name: Pilaster-Grid Office
notes: 1970s waffle grid: concrete pilaster+spandrel lattice with punched windows, stone base, protruding pilaster-cap posts, wraparound floor-1 canopy (庇), rooftop penthouse.

name: Dark Louver Fin Tower
notes: Modern black curtain wall with full-height protruding vertical louver fins, a lit orange stair-core stripe, blackstone entrance canopy, coped parapet + antenna mast.

name: Renaissance Palazzo Rusticato
notes: Florentine palazzo: two-tone rusticated stone base, sandstone piano nobile, toothed calcite quoins, keystone posts over windows, protruding string courses each floor, cornice and parapet posts.

name: Doric Temple Colonnade
notes: Greek temple: stylobate base, giant-order columns (thin diorite_wall shafts with plinth and capital) all around, triglyph/metope frieze band, overhanging cornice, stepped gable roof with solid calcite pediments on both ends.

name: Neoclassical Bank
notes: Beaux-Arts bank: rusticated granite arcade base with keystones, light-gray upper body with giant andesite pilaster strips, stepped plinth ring, dentil course under the cornice, and a full balustrade parapet (posts + rail cap).

name: Baroque Yellow Palace
notes: Schoenbrunn-style baroque: yellow terracotta body with alternating white quoins, white window aediculae (pediment slab + sill), diorite pilaster strips between bays, quartz belt courses, wrought-iron balcony over the door, and a centered attic crown on the parapet.

name: Georgian Brick Townhouse
notes: Georgian/Federal: red-brick (terracotta) walls, calcite toothed quoins and flat lintels with diorite keystones, stone sills, belt courses, dentil cornice, columned entry portico with canopy, and a stepped slate hip roof (deepslate + blackstone slabs).

name: Georgian Row House
notes: 赤煉瓦(brick_stairs)本体に砂岩の帯(string course)と隅石、白いまぐさ/窓台、張出しコーニス＋brick_wallパラペット、中央にダークオークの玄関扉。

name: Tudor Half-Timber
notes: 1階は煉瓦、上階はハーフティンバー(白漆喰infillにダークオークの柱・梁・斜め筋交い)。各上階に張出しの持送り、切妻屋根とドーマー窓。

name: Victorian Bay Terrace
notes: 煉瓦本体に交互の砂岩隅石と帯。正面に2層分の張出し出窓(bay window)をz=-1へ突出、砂岩スラブの庇＋張出しコーニスとsandstone_wallパラペット。

name: Banded Brick + Mansard
notes: 帯状の多色煉瓦(白帯＋赤/茶の縞)にアーチ状まぐさ(brick_slab)。正面に鉄柵バルコニー(iron_bars)を張出し、ネザー煉瓦の急勾配マンサード屋根＋正面ドーマー。

name: Dutch Crow-Step Gable
notes: 煉瓦本体に砂岩の帯と隅柱、縦長窓。各階に張出しの砂岩コーニス、正面/背面に段状破風(crow-step gable)が屋根上へ立ち上がり、ダークオークの切妻屋根＋ドーマー。

name: Egg-Crate Grid Recess
notes: White concrete egg-crate frame protrudes one block on floor lines, every-3rd column, and corners, making the gray/glass wall plane read as deeply recessed; slab cornice ring overhangs the flat roof with a stone-brick parapet.

name: Cantilever Box Bays
notes: Staggered checkerboard of protruding glass box bays (white sill, quartz-slab lip, orange terracotta showing through) alternating per floor with recessed balconies of stone-slab decks and iron-bar rails; quartz canopy over the glazed entry.

name: Vertical Louver Curtain
notes: Black-frame curtain wall (clear glass + light-blue spandrel band) screened by full-height andesite-wall louver fins on every other column, spruce corner piers, spruce-slab floor-line stubs between fins, and a setback spruce rooftop volume.

name: Stacked Setback Terraces
notes: Each floor steps inward (ziggurat massing) leaving terraces edged with iron-bar railings and oak-leaf corner planters; white body with gray floor bands, ground-floor andesite-wall pilaster colonnade outside, dark-oak entry canopy, parapet crown.

name: Horizontal Slab Bands
notes: Continuous quartz-slab bands wrap every floor line and overhang the roof; ribbon glazing with dark-oak mullions, alternating iron-bar balcony rails per floor, black spandrel stripes, and red terracotta accent studs punctuating the corners.

name: Beton Ribbon Warehouse
notes: Exposed-concrete warehouse: white pilasters every 4 bays, continuous light-blue ribbon glazing, protruding stone belt courses at each floor line, rooftop parapet with recessed quartz deck and a slab entrance canopy.

name: Corrugated Steel Factory
notes: Industrial shed: alternating white/light-gray vertical corrugation stripes with thin andesite-wall rib posts standing proud, clerestory glazing band, and a stepped gable roof with stone-slab eave cap and a raised ridge vent.

name: Red Brick School
notes: Civic red-brick schoolhouse: brown-terracotta piers every 3 bays that protrude as full-block pilasters, tall white-glass classroom windows, painted white sill bands, sandstone belt courses/coping, parapet, and a columned south entrance porch.

name: Civic Curtain Wall
notes: Modern public-library curtain wall: white structural bays framing continuous blue/clear glass, thin diorite-wall mullions between panes, projecting quartz-slab horizontal sun-shade fins at every floor line, gray plinth, parapet, and a full-width entrance canopy.

name: Industrial Mill Monitor Roof
notes: Heavy concrete mill: wide light-gray piers every 5 bays that project as deep pilasters, dark-oak ground-floor loading bays, glazed grid windows crossed by iron-bar mullions, a bold andesite cornice, and a raised clerestory monitor lantern running down the roof center.

name: Vermilion Irimoya Hall
notes: Red pillars/nuki beams on white plaster, orange shoji front, protruding kohai porch with posts+canopy+stone steps, stepped hip roof shell of dark slabs/planks.

name: Five-Tier Vermilion Pagoda
notes: Every floor gets a protruding dark eave ring plus iron-bars balcony rail on the tier below; red corner columns, kumimono bracket band, crowning pyramid with 3-block sourin finial.

name: Torii-Front Timber Shrine
notes: Unpainted spruce-log frame shrine on cobblestone plinth with a full vermilion torii (posts, nuki, overhanging kasagi) standing at the street front, spruce-slab gable roof with infilled gable ends.

name: Zen Shinkabe Temple
notes: White plaster with dark-oak timber grid (shinkabe), granite base, protruding mokoshi pent-skirt ring at y=3, thin deepslate-wall pilaster relief on the front, black tiled gable roof with striped gable ends.

name: Copper-Roof Worship Hall
notes: White hall with red-terracotta pillars on deepslate base, front veranda deck (spruce slabs) with iron-bars railing broken at the center entrance, weathered-copper hip roof of alternating prismarine slab/full tiers, gilt yellow ridge ornament.

name: shirokon_flat
notes: White-concrete koban, flat roof + parapet, iron-bar lattice windows, red KOBAN band, gray porch canopy on pilasters, red beacon lamp over the door.

name: shitami_gable
notes: Clapboard (shitami-ita) wooden koban: spruce/dark-oak siding with protruding shadow-line slabs, stepped gable roof with closed ends, spruce-log porch posts, red lamp.

name: glass_modern
notes: Modern glazed koban: prismarine plinth, glass curtain with slim iron-bar mullions, gray floor bands, blue KOBAN band, full-width protruding canopy, red beacon.

name: kado_tower
notes: Sandstone corner koban with a tall front-corner red-lamp tower (beacon), overhanging eave stairs, low slab roof and sandstone-wall parapet, orange lattice windows.

name: renga_arch
notes: Brick-tone koban: mottled red/brown terracotta walls with white quoins, brick-stair cornice ring, arched brick porch (voussoir stairs), brick-wall parapet, red lamp.

name: SevenStripe
notes: White body, tri-color horizontal sign band (orange/white/green/red), glass storefront with light-gray mullions, protruding entrance canopy + iron-bars posts, flat roof with quartz coping and a rooftop sign pylon.

name: LawsonWrap
notes: Full-height blue corner pilasters frame a corner-wrapping glass storefront (front + both sides) with iron-bars accents, a solid light-blue sign band, a blue awning ledge protruding out front, and blue-coped parapet with corner uplights.

name: FamiPilaster
notes: Green concrete pilasters protrude one cell out front and repeat every third bay, dividing glass panels; a green/blue/white sign band, a deep green eave overhanging the whole frontage (x=-1..W), and green-coped parapet.

name: DriveThruCanopy
notes: Roadside gas-station look: a wide flat white canopy juts two cells out front (x=-1..W) on three tall pillars, with a red/yellow fascia band; full clear-glass storefront, yellow-and-red sign band and yellow-coped flat roof.

name: GlassGridPylon
notes: Modern curtain-wall storefront: iron-bars mullions and light-blue glass form a full grid, white spandrel bands mark each floor, a red-terracotta plinth grounds it, a tall red/white rooftop pylon sign rises at the front corner, and a slab canopy shades the entrance.

name: wood_gable
notes: 木造切妻駅舎: white-plaster + spruce timber framing, gable roof with eaves, spruce-column porte-cochere, central ticket gate, gable clock.

name: rc_ribbon
notes: RC駅舎: light-gray concrete with continuous ribbon windows + mullion piers, spandrel bands, flat roof + cornice/parapet, cantilever entrance canopy on iron tie-rods, wide ticket-gate opening.

name: hip_brick
notes: 寄棟(hip-roof)煉瓦駅舎: brown-terracotta brick walls with sandstone quoins/bands, arched window heads, four-sided stepped hip roof with ridge cap, stone-column porte-cochere, upper clock.

name: irimoya_shrine
notes: 和風(入母屋)駅舎: white walls with dark-oak posts, blackstone-slab double-eave skirt + deep-overhang gable roof with ridge crest, torii-style entry posts + entry canopy, gable clock.

name: platform_lean
notes: 下屋付き木造駅舎: spruce timber-frame gable box (ridge along street) with gable ends, plus a long sloped platform-side lean-to (下屋) on posts off the back, street ticket gate + small entrance canopy, clock.

name: karahafu_irimoya
notes: White-plaster sento with a big irimoya (hip-and-gable) tiled roof, a karahafu bump over the noren doorway, spruce corner posts, iron-bar lattice and slab lintels.

name: tall_chimney
notes: The iconic sento silhouette: a tall banded brick chimney (brick/nether-brick courses + flared cap) towering over a cyan kawara gable roof; oak-rail walls, lattice, indigo noren.

name: noren_lattice
notes: Machiya-front bathhouse: a full-height koushi (iron-bar + timber) lattice screen on the street, a wide tricolor noren band, under a four-slope hip roof with protruding tokyo bracket-slabs.

name: irimoya_grand
notes: Grand miya-zukuri sento: a chidori-hafu triangular gable faces the street with a king-post/strut timber pediment and gable slit-window, plus a mokoshi lower pent-roof skirt for the two-tier look.

name: karahafu_porch
notes: High-end genkan projecting to the street under a big bell-curved karahafu gable (upturned cusp tips + red gegyo crest) with a slab canopy, all beneath a blue-kawara hip roof.

name: Namako Diamond Kura
notes: Classic dozou: diagonal white-diamond namako wall base over black tiles, black corner pilasters and floor bands, kannon double doors flung open, barred slit windows, blackstone cornice ring and stepped tile gable roof.

name: Okiyane Float-Roof Kura
notes: Placed-roof (okiyane) storehouse: checkerboard namako skirt, spruce-log corner posts, roof deck floats on short posts with a visible air gap, overhanging plank deck, indigo noren and slab canopy over the entry.

name: Udatsu Machiya-Kura
notes: Merchant machiya with protruding udatsu firewalls rising past the eaves on both sides (slab-capped, black base), timber lattice-and-glass shopfront, dark beam bands each floor, mushiko windows with iron-bar lattice, slab hisashi canopy, deepslate tile gable.

name: Kurogura Black-Plaster Kura
notes: Kawagoe-style black-plaster kura: massive white hachimaki band under a double stone-slab cornice, kannon window with glowing slit and protruding open black shutters, deep door reveal, huge hako-mune box ridge with wall-post onigawara finials at both ends.

name: Kurashiki Grid-Namako Hip Kura
notes: Kurashiki-style: square-grid namako (white joint lines over black tiles) up to mid-height, gray mizukiri band, cobblestone plinth with protruding slab skirt, black door surround with slab jamb reliefs, barred slits, and a stepped hip (yosemune) roof on all four sides.

name: rc_schoolhouse
notes: RC打放し校舎。長い footprint に規則的リボン窓、階ごとのスパンドレル帯、陸屋根+パラペット、正面に庇。

name: clapboard_wing
notes: 下見板張り木造校舎。spruce板壁+隅の柱、軒蛇腹帯、規則窓、長軸の切妻大屋根(軒の張り出し付き)。

name: kamaboko_gym
notes: かまぼこ屋根の体育館。放物線状に段積みした樽型ヴォールト、妻壁を塞ぐ、高い連続クリアストーリー窓。

name: gable_gym
notes: 切妻大屋根の体育館。腰壁+背の高い大窓、長壁に張り出す控え柱(バットレス)、長軸の大きな切妻屋根。

name: clocktower_school
notes: 時計塔付き校舎。白タイル壁に赤煉瓦帯と規則窓、陸屋根+パラペット、正面中央に張り出す時計塔と切妻頂冠。

name: Colonnade Ministry
notes: White stone government hall: full-height sandstone pilaster colonnade protruding on the front, rusticated base, string-course cornice, flat roof with balustrade parapet, and a central protruding portico canopy over glass doors.

name: Meiji Brick Library
notes: Meiji-era red-brick library: red-terracotta brick field with white stone quoins at corners, white horizontal string courses, brick pilaster strips, a stepped gray hip roof, quartz cornice, and a central white canopy entry.

name: Irimoya Community Hall
notes: Wayo-secchu community hall: white-tile masonry body on a stone plinth with dark-oak timber string course and full-cube oak columns, a deep protruding dark-oak eave, and a stepped gray tiled gable roof with timber gable-end triangles.

name: Taisho Tiled Office
notes: Taisho scratch-tile civic office: white-tile field with full-height light-gray tile pilaster strips and protruding stone-brick pilasters, granite base, horizontal string courses, flat roof with stone-brick parapet, and a wide central canopy over a tall glazed entrance.

name: Grand Stone Library
notes: Neoclassical public library: rusticated cobble/stone base, sandstone body with calcite string courses, a projecting central portico of thin sandstone columns carrying an entablature and a stepped calcite triangular pediment, flat roof with a sandstone-wall balustrade.
